definitions.explanation: Physical variation in height, such as hills and valleys in landscape or waves.
Figurative variation or fluctuation, such as emotional changes or life circumstances.

examples.japanese: {起伏|きふく}のある{地形|ちけい}を{歩|ある}く。
この{道|みち}は{起伏|きふく}が{多|おお}くて{疲|つか}れる。
examples.english: This road has many ups and downs and is tiring.

examples.japanese: {起伏|きふく}に{富|と}んだ{山道|やまみち}をハイキングした。
examples.english: We hiked a mountain trail full of elevation changes.

examples.japanese: {感情|かんじょう}の{起伏|きふく}が{激|はげ}しい。
{人生|じんせい}は{起伏|きふく}に{富|と}んでいる。
examples.english: Life is full of ups and downs.

examples.japanese: {起伏|きふく}の{少|すく}ない{穏|おだ}やかな{日々|ひび}を{送|おく}りたい。
examples.english: I want to live calm days without many ups and downs.

notes:
{起伏|きふく} combines {起|き} (rise) and {伏|ふく} (fall/lie down).

PHYSICAL USAGE:
- {起伏|きふく}のある{道|みち}: undulating road
- {起伏|きふく}に{富|と}む{地形|ちけい}: terrain rich in elevation changes

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
- {感情|かんじょう}の{起伏|きふく}: emotional ups and downs
- {人生|じんせい}の{起伏|きふく}: life's vicissitudes
- {起伏|きふく}に{富|と}む{物語|ものがたり}: story full of twists
